Frozen_primary_biological_model: MS3 represents a cross-patient proliferative malignant state characterized primarily by mitotic entry, spindle and chromosome-segregation machinery, cytokinesis and chromosomal-instability-associated transcription. The state additionally shows replication-stress, DNA-repair and nucleotide-synthesis requirements, with residual enrichment of RNA processing, ribosome biogenesis, DNA maintenance and chromatin regulation after operational exclusion of dominant cell-cycle genes. MS3 is opposed by loss of hepatic differentiation and bile-acid metabolic identity.

Residual_analysis.Interpretation: Operational removal of frozen Core100 plus Hallmark G2M/E2F and curated mitotic genes did not eliminate DNA-repair, replication-fork, RNA-processing and chromatin-related enrichment.
Residual_analysis.Important_limit: Residual enrichment must not be interpreted as fully independent of proliferative biology.

Next_step: Step27 trajectory analysis will examine whether the frozen malignant states occupy reproducible transition relationships, with particular attention to the MS6 differentiated/metabolic to MS3 proliferative axis. Trajectory directionality will not be assumed in advance.
